summary: Iteration-44 review: verified the Compare Dashboard Widget end-to-end. New backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_iter44_features.py (6 tests) all pass — empty-state zero counts, correct compare_route per pathway, per-pathway active-count increments after linking, auth required, revoke returns to zero, and /api/deep-dives/status regression. Re-ran iter42 (20/20 pass) and iter43 (17/17 pass + 1 pre-existing skip on coparenting-report share label). Frontend Playwright walk-through: seeded 2 shares (educational + psychological) via API, logged in as parent1@test.com, dismissed legal-ack modal + skipped orientation, dashboard-compare-card renders with headline '2 active', per-pathway pills read '1 pending' (educational), '1 pending' (psychological), 'None yet' (medical), clicking the educational row correctly navigates to /special-needs-v2/educational-deep-dive/compare. Revoked all shares via API, reloaded /dashboard, and confirmed dashboard-compare-card is not rendered (count=0) — hidden-when-empty invariant holds.
critical_code_review_comments: deep_dives_routes._compare_counts issues a repeat db lookup for the current user's assessment inside the async-for loop (once per share). Minor: hoist the me_a fetch out of the loop and cache by pathway. Not a correctness bug, but O(active_shares) extra queries per pathway.

Dashboard.jsx fires /deep-dives/status and /deep-dives/compare-status in parallel in the same effect (good). Consider merging the two endpoints server-side to save one round-trip, since both are dashboard-only aggregators over the same DEEP_DIVES config.

GET /api/deep-dives/compare-status has no server-side caching. Dashboard mount cost is 3× shares_collection.find(user_pair, status!=revoked). For a heavy user this is fine, but revisit if shares become a hot collection.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: created 2 non-revoked shares (edu-deep, psych-deep) between parent1 and parent2 for the UI walkthrough. Revoked at end of run. Autouse cleanup in test_iter44_features.py revokes any leftover shares in all 3 pathways for both parents before and after the module.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-44 adds GET /api/deep-dives/compare-status and the Dashboard tile (`dashboard-compare-card`). Any future pathway added to DEEP_DIVES in deep_dives_routes.py will automatically be reflected in both /status and /compare-status responses and in the tile rows — extend PATHWAY_PREFIXES in test_iter44_features.py and the row-count assertion (currently == 3) accordingly. When testing the UI, remember to (a) dismiss the legal-ack modal FIRST (it appears on top of the orientation page), then (b) click orientation-skip-button to reach /dashboard.
rca of the issue: N/A — no regressions or bugs found.
